title: Towards a Fundamental Principle for $λ$-Homogeneous Solutions on Cones
summary: We prove a weak fundamental principle for $λ$-homogeneous solutions of homogeneous constant-coefficient systems on open pointed convex cones. Starting with the solution family $S_{\mathcal B}$ arising in the Ehrenpreis--Palamodov theory, we construct a corresponding family $S_{\mathcal B,λ}$ by replacing the exponential kernels $e^{\langle x,z\rangle}$ with homogeneous kernels $(-\langle x,z\rangle)^λ$.
